Project Title: Assessing the Impact of Stochastic Cloud Microphysics in Convection-Resolving Models Using GOES-R Satellite Observations
Project Goal: The goal of this project is to implement a stochastic parameter perturbation (SPP) technique in the Thompson-Eidhammer cloud microphysics parameterization scheme that will add perturbations to key microphysical process rates in a statistically and physically consistent manner.

Project Description: To implement a stochastic parameter perturbation (SPP) technique in the Thompson-Eidhammer cloud microphysics parameterization scheme that will add perturbations to key microphysical process rates in a statistically and physically consistent manner.
